bulletin.morning: The Northern Limit of Monsoon continues to pass through 20°N/60°E, 20°N/65°E, 20°N/70°E, Surat, Indore, Mandla, Daltonganj, Motihari and 28.3°N/83°E on 28th June Conditions are favourable for further advance of southwest monsoon into some more parts of North Arabian Sea, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, remaining parts of Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand & Bihar, some parts of Uttar Pradesh & Uttarakhand during next 3-4 days.

met_analysis:
The Northern Limit of Monsoon continues to pass through 20°N/60°E, 20°N/65°E, 20°N/70°E, Surat, Indore, Mandla, Daltonganj, Motihari and 28.3°N/83°E as on 28 th June.
Conditions are favourable for further advance of southwest monsoon into some more parts of North Arabian Sea, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh, remaining parts of Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand & Bihar, some parts of Uttar Pradesh & Uttarakhand during next 2-3 days.
The seasonal trough at mean sea level from Punjab to Bihar across Haryana and Uttar Pradesh persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Telangana & neighbourhood between 3.1 to 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from northern parts of Coastal Andhra Pradesh to Marathwada across Chhattisgarh, cyclonic circulation over north Telangana & neighbourhood between 3.1 km & 4.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The trough from northern parts of central Uttar Pradesh to west Vidarbha across Madhya Pradesh at 1.5 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over north Gujarat & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over westcentral Bay of Bengal & adjoining south Coastal Andhra Pradesh at 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over central Chhattisgarh & adjoining Odisha at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The upper air cyclonic circulation over east Bihar & neighbourhood at 0.9 km above mean sea level persists.
The Western Disturbance asa cyclonic circulation over Haryana & neighbourhood between 3.1 & 5.8 km above mean sea level persists.
